subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox own `cloud-run-sandbox` as a built-in public-preview provider, including its operator-managed remote gateway contract, or should that integration remain outside the core provider set for now?
rationale: Source review and real-service proof support technical viability, but neither can determine whether Crabbox should commit to this preview service, its gateway deployment model, and its new user-facing provider/configuration surface.

options.title: Hold for core sponsorship
options.body: Pause merge until a core owner explicitly accepts ownership of the public-preview provider and gateway contract.

options.title: Accept the built-in preview provider
options.body: Merge with an explicit maintainer decision to support the documented gateway, aliases, flags, and upgrade expectations as a preview integration.

options.title: Keep it outside core
options.body: Do not merge the built-in provider now; the contributor may maintain the integration externally until the core contract is wanted.

recommendation.title: Hold for core sponsorship
recommendation.body: Pause merge until a core owner explicitly accepts ownership of the public-preview provider and gateway contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch history shows steipete carrying the provider lifecycle hardening and integration updates most relevant to the ownership decision.
